warnings: Type schedule with a printed จำนวน (count) per type — count is the printed number (cross-checked against the marks on A-03 แปลนพื้น). Marks kept as printed (ป = door, น = window).
Widths: where two widths are printed (frame / leaf) the outer one is width_m and the inner one leaf_width_m. Heights are measured to ระดับพื้นห้อง; every opening head prints at 2.05 except น5 (2.15).

น4 prints sill 0.85 + window 1.10 against an overall 2.05 (adds to 1.95), and its panel row 0.60 + 0.60 + 0.60 under an overall 2.00; น5 prints 1.65 + 0.40 against an overall 2.15 (adds to 2.05). Printed values kept, flagged — no reading chosen over another.
